title: 第492章 万象魔手
slug: 天赋太差全凭系统黑化
content_zh:
欧阳庄主在与林雲的交锋中发下，林雲身上的武境血脉之力并非是普通的红色品阶，而是超越金色品阶的传说级血色品阶。
“林雲，你到底是什么人？为何会拥有传说级的血色武境血脉之力？”
欧阳庄主被林雲的武境品阶所震撼，身为欧阳家族的家主，欧阳庄主不得不琢磨林雲的身份，万一林雲是来自哪个强大古族的后代，欧阳家族很可能会招来麻烦。欧阳庄主必须提前做好方法。
欧阳庄主见林雲没有回应，再度凝聚出强大的攻击，一道道圣境道则疯狂涌动，虚空天地仿佛破碎一般，可怕的空间风暴轻易撕开这片天地。
“万象魔手！”欧阳庄主大喝一声，一道覆盖天地的掌印朝着林雲轰来。
可怕的万象魔手封锁住虚空，强大的神威道则叠加在万象魔手之上，让林雲无处可逃。
恐怖的万象魔手轰来，林雲当即祭出无极混元之帝王烈焰掌挡在身前。狂暴的万象魔手发出阵阵呼啸之声，重重的拍在帝王怒焰掌之上。
轰鸣的魔威一掌拍碎帝王怒焰掌，强大的冲击力把空间轰出了一个时空裂缝。林雲顿时感觉到可怕的空间风暴在撕扯自己，瞬间就将自己给扯入空间风暴之中。
欧阳庄主见林雲被轰入空间裂缝，随即一个闪身犹如炮弹一般射入空间裂缝之中。
众人望着消失的两人，欧阳山庄的气氛瞬间凝固了。两人狂暴的战斗竟然破开空间裂缝，现在林雲、欧阳冷傲两人进入空间裂缝之中，虚空天地间神威涌动的风暴才渐渐平息。
两人身上都附着神威罡气防御，在漆黑的裂缝虚空之中，宛若两盏微弱的烛光。两人不仅要面对对手的攻击，同时需要抵御空间罡气的威压。
空间罡气是破碎的额大道空间之力所形成的能量罡气，这种罡气风暴蕴含各种规则之力，空间规则之力、时空之力、风火雷电之力、五行规则之力，各种破碎的大道之力混成可怕的罡气风暴，可以轻易将人撕碎。
content_en:
During the confrontation with Lin Yun, Master Ouyang discovered that the power of the martial arts bloodline in Lin Yun was not an ordinary red grade, but a legendary blood grade that surpassed the gold grade.
"Lin Yun, who are you? Why do you have the legendary bloodline power of the Blood Martial Realm?"
Villa Master Ouyang was shocked by Lin Yun's martial arts level. As the head of the Ouyang family, Villa Master Ouyang had to think about Lin Yun's identity. If Lin Yun was a descendant of some powerful ancient clan, the Ouyang family would probably be in trouble. Owner Ouyang must prepare the method in advance.
Seeing that Lin Yun didn't respond, Master Ouyang gathered a powerful attack again. Saint realm paths surged crazily. The void world seemed to be broken, and the terrifying space storm easily tore the world apart.
"The Magic Hand of All Things!" Master Ouyang shouted loudly, and a palm print covering the world rushed towards Lin Yun.
The terrifying All-Seeing Demonic Hand blocked the void, and the powerful divine power was superimposed on the All-Seeing Demonic Hand, leaving Lin Yun with nowhere to escape.
The terrifying demonic hand of all phenomena came, and Lin Yun immediately used the Emperor's Flame Palm of Wuji Hunyuan to block it in front of him. The violent all-seeing demonic hand made bursts of whistling sounds and slapped heavily on the emperor's wrathful palm.
The roaring demonic power smashed the emperor's wrathful palm with one palm, and the powerful impact blasted a space-time rift in the space. Lin Yun suddenly felt the terrifying space storm tearing him apart, and he was instantly pulled into the space storm.
The owner of Ouyang Village saw Lin Yun being blasted into the space crack, and then he ducked and shot into the space crack like a cannonball.
Everyone looked at the two people who had disappeared, and the atmosphere in Ouyang Villa instantly solidified. The violent battle between the two actually broke through the space crack. Now that Lin Yun and Ouyang Lengao entered the space crack, the storm of divine power in the void, heaven and earth gradually subsided.
Both of them were equipped with divine power to defend themselves, and they were like two weak candles in the dark cracked void. The two of them not only have to face the opponent's attacks, but also need to resist the pressure of space energy.
Space Gangqi is the energy Gangqi formed by the broken space power of the great avenue. This Gangqi storm contains the power of various rules, the power of space rules, the power of time and space, the power of wind, fire, thunder and lightning, and the power of the five elements rules. Various broken avenue powers mix into a terrifying Gangqi storm, which can easily tear people apart.
